concepts.gloss_en: Sarah — the matriarch, associated with malchut, song (shir), and speech (dibbur)

members.note: representative; Sarah the matriarch / shir / malchut

concepts.gloss_en: Marah — the place of bitter waters (Exodus 15), symbol of blemished bris / bitter waters

members.note: the bitter waters of Marah; wholly unrelated to Sarah — grouped only by surface consonant similarity

notes: Not the same concept. Mechanical merge was driven by orthographic resemblance (שרה/מרה), but the proofs show Sarah (matriarch/song/malchut) vs. Marah (bitter waters of Exodus 15). Kept fully separate per under-merge-beats-over-merge.
